svg.title: fixed-lineage
svg.desc: Three fixed sparse patterns on a toy 24×24 query×key grid. Sparse Transformer (2019): local band of l = 4 plus every 4th key, causal, so any pair connects in two hops (example 23 → 3 → 1). Longformer (2020): window of ±3 plus global tokens 0 and 1. BigBird (2020): 3-block window, one global block and one random block per query block. Real configs at n = 4,096: Sparse Transformer with l = 64 reads at most 128 keys per query; Longformer window 512; BigBird-ITC 128 global + 192 window + 192 random = 512 keys. GPT-3 alternated dense and banded layers; gpt-oss does the same with a 128-token band.
